blocks.zh: 知識移轉階段與備料階段
blocks.en: Knowledge Transfer Stage and Readiness Stage

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — KT 階段總覽
blocks.en: Commentary: Overview of the KT Stage

blocks.zh: 知識管理的兩大類型
blocks.en: Two Types of Knowledge Management

blocks.zh: 顯性知識（Explicit Knowledge）：可以文字記錄的內容，例如 SOP、批次記錄、驗證報告、規格書。這類知識容易轉移，用文件包（TT Package）即可傳遞。
blocks.en: Explicit knowledge: content that can be written down, such as SOPs, batch records, validation reports, and specifications. This type of knowledge is easy to transfer and can be passed on through the TT Package.

blocks.zh: 隱性知識（Tacit Knowledge）：存在於人腦中的操作經驗，例如「這個設備起動時要先熱機 10 分鐘才穩定」、「過濾時壓力突然升高通常是進料黏度問題而非濾膜阻塞」。這類知識很難靠文件傳遞，必須透過現場觀察、人員訓練、face-to-face 互動才能捕捉。
blocks.en: Tacit knowledge: operating experience that lives in people's heads, for example "this equipment must warm up for 10 minutes at start-up before it is stable" or "a sudden pressure rise during filtration is usually a feed viscosity problem, not membrane blockage." This knowledge is hard to pass on in documents; it has to be captured through on-site observation, personnel training, and face-to-face interaction.

blocks.zh: TR65 特別指出：隱性知識的轉移往往是最有價值但最難執行的部分。
blocks.en: TR65 specifically points out that the transfer of tacit knowledge is often the most valuable part and also the hardest to carry out.

blocks.zh: 比喻：食譜 vs. 廚藝傳承
blocks.en: Analogy: Recipe vs. Passing On the Craft of Cooking

blocks.zh: 想像你要把一道米其林餐廳的招牌菜教給另一家廚房：
blocks.en: Imagine teaching the signature dish of a Michelin-starred restaurant to another kitchen:

blocks.zh: 食譜 = 顯性知識（SOP、批次記錄）：寫出材料與步驟
blocks.en: The recipe = explicit knowledge (SOPs, batch records): it spells out the ingredients and steps.

blocks.zh: 主廚親自到場示範 = 隱性知識轉移：「這個醬汁要炒到『聞起來像焦糖』才是對的顏色」
blocks.en: The head chef demonstrating in person = tacit knowledge transfer: "This sauce has to be cooked until it smells like caramel; that is the right color."

blocks.zh: 學徒做給主廚看 = 工程批（Engineering Batch）：驗證接收端真的學會了
blocks.en: The apprentice cooking while the head chef watches = the engineering batch: it verifies that the receiving side has really learned it.

blocks.zh: TT Package 只是食譜。光有食譜而沒有主廚示範，往往做不出一樣的味道。
blocks.en: The TT Package is only the recipe. With a recipe but no demonstration by the head chef, you often cannot reproduce the same taste.

blocks.zh: 重點：KT 階段的三大輸出
blocks.en: Key Point: The Three Main Outputs of the KT Stage

blocks.zh: SU Technical Package：送出端提供的完整技術文件包
blocks.en: SU Technical Package: the complete technical documentation package provided by the sending unit

blocks.zh: RU Technical Package：接收端消化後建立的自有技術文件
blocks.en: RU Technical Package: the receiving unit's own technical documentation, built after it has absorbed the SU material

blocks.zh: Stage Gate Approval：指導委員會確認 TT Package 完整性後的放行
blocks.en: Stage Gate Approval: release granted by the Steering Committee after it confirms the completeness of the TT Package

blocks.zh: KT 階段結束時，指導委員會（Steering Committee）必須確認 TT package 完整，並評估殘餘風險因子及其緩解策略。
blocks.en: At the end of the KT stage, the Steering Committee must confirm that the TT package is complete and assess the residual risk factors and their mitigation strategies.

blocks.zh: CDMO 現場情境
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario

blocks.zh: 對於接收產品的 CDMO（RU），KT 階段的核心挑戰是：你不知道你不知道什麼。客戶（SU/MAH）提供的文件包可能遺漏了他們認為「理所當然」的操作細節。
blocks.en: For a CDMO receiving a product (the RU), the core challenge of the KT stage is that you do not know what you do not know. The package provided by the client (SU/MAH) may omit operating details that they consider "a given."

blocks.zh: 實務建議：在 KT kick-off 之前，CDMO 應先進行內部的 Knowledge Gap Assessment，列出：我們目前缺乏哪些關於這個製程/產品的資訊？再帶著問題清單去跟 SU 溝通，而不是被動接收文件。
blocks.en: Practical advice: before the KT kick-off, the CDMO should run an internal Knowledge Gap Assessment listing what information about this process/product we currently lack. Then go to the SU with a list of questions, rather than passively receiving documents.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — Business / PM / Process / Analytical
blocks.en: Commentary: Business / PM / Process / Analytical

blocks.zh: Business 功能在 KT 階段的角色
blocks.en: The Role of Business in the KT Stage

blocks.zh: Business 在 KT 階段的核心任務是移除合約障礙（remove contractual roadblocks）。實務上，這包括：確保 NDA/CDA 覆蓋範圍足夠廣、解決知識產權（IP）分歸問題、確保技術文件的使用授權不受限制。
blocks.en: The core task of Business in the KT stage is to remove contractual roadblocks. In practice this includes making sure the NDA/CDA scope is broad enough, resolving intellectual property (IP) ownership questions, and making sure the right to use the technical documents is not restricted.

blocks.zh: 若 TT 是 CDMO 接案，Business 還需確保 Quality Agreement 與 Technical Agreement 中對知識轉移的責任分工已明確定義。
blocks.en: If the TT is a CDMO engagement, Business must also make sure that the Quality Agreement and Technical Agreement clearly define the division of responsibility for knowledge transfer.

blocks.zh: TT PM 在 KT 的核心職責
blocks.en: Core Responsibilities of the TT PM in KT

blocks.zh: 知識搬運工：確保 SU 的 know-how 完整傳遞給 RU，不只是文件，還包括現場示範
blocks.en: Knowledge carrier: ensure the SU's know-how is passed to the RU completely, not only as documents but also through on-site demonstrations

blocks.zh: 隱性知識捕手：安排 SU/RU 人員面對面互動，記錄到 KM 系統
blocks.en: Tacit knowledge catcher: arrange face-to-face interaction between SU/RU personnel and record the results in the KM system

blocks.zh: 進度控管者：定期 TT Team 會議追蹤交付物、阻礙、行動事項
blocks.en: Progress controller: track deliverables, obstacles, and action items through regular TT Team meetings

blocks.zh: 過去教訓整合者：引入前次 TT 的 lessons learned，避免重蹈覆轍
blocks.en: Lessons-learned integrator: bring in lessons learned from previous TTs to avoid repeating mistakes

blocks.zh: Process VMP — 關鍵交付物
blocks.en: Process VMP: Key Deliverable

blocks.zh: 製程驗證主計畫（Process VMP）是 KT 階段 Process 功能的核心文件，它規劃了後續 PPQ 的所有要求，是 Readiness 和 Execution 階段的路線圖。
blocks.en: The Process Validation Master Plan (Process VMP) is the core document of the Process function in the KT stage. It lays out all the requirements for the subsequent PPQ and is the roadmap for the Readiness and Execution stages.

blocks.zh: 特別注意：Process VMP 中的成功標準（Success Criteria）必須在 Readiness 之前完成定義，這是 stage gate 的必要條件之一。
blocks.en: Special note: the success criteria in the Process VMP must be defined before Readiness; this is one of the prerequisites for the stage gate.

blocks.zh: 比喻：分析方法轉移像「廚師的刀工認證」
blocks.en: Analogy: Analytical Method Transfer Is Like a "Chef's Knife-Skills Certification"

blocks.zh: Analytical 在 KT 階段制定的驗證計畫，就像把 SU 廚師用的切菜技術「認證」給 RU 廚師：
blocks.en: The validation plan that Analytical prepares in the KT stage is like "certifying" the cutting technique used by the SU chef for the RU chef:

blocks.zh: 非藥典法（Non-compendial）：SU 自己開發的方法，需要在 RU 做 method transfer（含系統適用性確認）
blocks.en: Non-compendial: methods developed by the SU itself, which require a method transfer at the RU (including system suitability confirmation)

blocks.zh: 藥典法（Compendial）：USP/EP 方法，RU 需要確認自己的設備符合要求（method verification）
blocks.en: Compendial: USP/EP methods, for which the RU needs to confirm that its own equipment meets the requirements (method verification)

blocks.zh: 參考標準品（Reference Standards）：KT 階段就要確認來源與訂購，因為等待時間可能是關鍵路徑
blocks.en: Reference Standards: sources and orders must be confirmed already in the KT stage, because the waiting time may be on the critical path

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — KT 階段
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise: KT Stage

blocks.zh: 你的公司在接收一個新產品時，是否有系統化的 Knowledge Gap Assessment 流程？還是只是等待 SU 寄文件？
blocks.en: When your company receives a new product, is there a systematic Knowledge Gap Assessment process, or do you just wait for the SU to send documents?

blocks.zh: 當 SU 的操作人員來 RU 示範時，你們如何確保隱性知識被記錄下來，而不只是「看了就忘」？
blocks.en: When SU operators come to the RU to demonstrate, how do you make sure the tacit knowledge is recorded rather than "seen and forgotten"?

blocks.zh: Process VMP 的 success criteria 是誰在定義？SU、RU、還是共同協商？這對後續 PPQ 爭議有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Who defines the success criteria of the Process VMP: the SU, the RU, or both by negotiation? How does this affect later PPQ disputes?

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — Engineering 至 Supply Chain
blocks.en: Commentary: Engineering through Supply Chain

blocks.zh: Facility-Fit Assessment — 設施適用性評估
blocks.en: Facility-Fit Assessment

blocks.zh: 這是 Engineering 在 KT 階段最關鍵的任務：將 SU 的製程要求與 RU 的現有設施能力逐項比對。
blocks.en: This is Engineering's most critical task in the KT stage: comparing the SU's process requirements item by item against the RU's existing facility capabilities.

blocks.zh: 評估涵蓋面向：
blocks.en: Areas covered by the assessment:

blocks.zh: 設備規格：容量、材質、控制系統是否相符
blocks.en: Equipment specifications: whether capacity, materials, and control systems match

blocks.zh: 廠房佈局：物料流向、人員動線、潔淨區等級
blocks.en: Facility layout: material flow, personnel flow, and cleanroom grade

blocks.zh: 公用設施：純水、壓縮空氣、HVAC 能否滿足製程需求
blocks.en: Utilities: whether purified water, compressed air, and HVAC can meet process needs

blocks.zh: 一次性系統（SUS）：管路、容器的設計與 E&L 要求
blocks.en: Single-use systems (SUS): design of tubing and containers, and E&L requirements

blocks.zh: 廢棄物管理：從產生到處置的完整系統
blocks.en: Waste management: the complete system from generation to disposal

blocks.zh: 重要原則：任何為了 facility-fit 而做的製程修改，必須在 Readiness 階段之前就驗證可行。不能把「不確定這樣改是否有效」的問題帶入 Readiness。
blocks.en: Key principle: any process change made for facility-fit reasons must be shown to be feasible before the Readiness stage. Questions such as "we are not sure whether this change will work" must not be carried into Readiness.

blocks.zh: URS — 使用者需求規格書是設備採購的起點
blocks.en: URS: The User Requirements Specification Is the Starting Point for Equipment Procurement

blocks.zh: Engineering 在 KT 階段寫 URS，是後續所有設備採購、設計圖、Capital VMP 的基礎文件。URS 的品質直接影響：
blocks.en: The URS that Engineering writes in the KT stage is the foundation document for all later equipment procurement, design drawings, and the Capital VMP. The quality of the URS directly affects:

blocks.zh: 報價準確性（CAR/資本申請）
blocks.en: Accuracy of quotations (CAR/capital appropriation request)

blocks.zh: 廠商選擇與合約
blocks.en: Vendor selection and contracts

blocks.zh: 設備資格確認計畫（IQ/OQ/PQ）的範疇
blocks.en: The scope of the equipment qualification plan (IQ/OQ/PQ)

blocks.zh: FAT/SAT 的查驗項目
blocks.en: The inspection items of FAT/SAT

blocks.zh: URS 如果定義不清，後續一路都會付出代價：設備不符需求、重做資格確認、延誤時程。
blocks.en: If the URS is poorly defined, you pay for it all the way down the line: equipment that does not meet requirements, repeated qualification, and schedule delays.

blocks.zh: Regulatory：可比性策略（Comparability Strategy）
blocks.en: Regulatory: Comparability Strategy

blocks.zh: TT 的核心監管問題是：RU 生產的產品與 SU 的產品是同一個嗎？
blocks.en: The core regulatory question of a TT is: is the product made by the RU the same as the SU's product?

blocks.zh: Regulatory 在 KT 階段必須定義可比性策略（Comparability Strategy），說明：
blocks.en: In the KT stage Regulatory must define the Comparability Strategy, explaining:

blocks.zh: 用什麼數據證明產品相同（理化、生物、穩定性）
blocks.en: What data will be used to show the product is the same (physicochemical, biological, stability)

blocks.zh: 矩陣法（Matrixing）如何應用在驗證批次設計上
blocks.en: How matrixing is applied in the design of the validation batches

blocks.zh: 是否需要事先與主管機關溝通，取得同意
blocks.en: Whether prior discussion with the health authority is needed to obtain agreement

blocks.zh: Post-Approval Change Management Protocol 是否適用（可降低後續申報類別）
blocks.en: Whether a Post-Approval Change Management Protocol applies (which may lower the later filing category)

blocks.zh: 比喻：Quality 的角色像「獨立驗收員」
blocks.en: Analogy: Quality's Role Is Like an "Independent Acceptance Inspector"

blocks.zh: 在 KT 階段，Quality 不只是負責審查文件，更像一個獨立的品管驗收員：
blocks.en: In the KT stage, Quality does more than review documents; it acts as an independent quality acceptance inspector:

blocks.zh: 對 SU 做「品質盡職調查」：偏差記錄、CAPA、市場行動、年度產品報告
blocks.en: Performs "quality due diligence" on the SU: deviation records, CAPA, market actions, annual product reports

blocks.zh: 對 RU 的供應商做資格稽核：確認關鍵原料的供應商符合品質要求
blocks.en: Performs qualification audits of the RU's suppliers: confirms that suppliers of critical raw materials meet quality requirements

blocks.zh: 對所有 VMP 和驗證計畫做符合性審查
blocks.en: Reviews all VMPs and validation plans for compliance

blocks.zh: Quality 的品質風險評估結果，直接決定了 KT 階段的 stage gate 能否通過。
blocks.en: The results of Quality's quality risk assessment directly determine whether the KT stage gate can be passed.

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：Bill of Materials 是供應鏈的 DNA
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: The Bill of Materials Is the DNA of the Supply Chain

blocks.zh: Supply Chain 在 KT 階段建立的 BOM（Bill of Materials），是 CDMO 接案後最重要的商業文件之一，因為它決定了：
blocks.en: The BOM (Bill of Materials) that Supply Chain builds in the KT stage is one of the most important commercial documents for a CDMO after it takes on a project, because it determines:

blocks.zh: 哪些原料需要客戶指定供應商（Approved Supplier List）
blocks.en: Which materials require a client-designated supplier (Approved Supplier List)

blocks.zh: 哪些可以 CDMO 自行採購（有議價空間）
blocks.en: Which the CDMO can purchase itself (where there is room to negotiate)

blocks.zh: 哪些原料的交期是專案關鍵路徑（最長前置時間 = 最早需要下單）
blocks.en: Which materials have lead times that sit on the project critical path (longest lead time = earliest order date)

blocks.zh: 是否有需要從 SU 取得樣品用於工程批的物料
blocks.en: Whether any materials need samples from the SU for use in the engineering batch

blocks.zh: BOM 建立不完整，往往是 Readiness 階段材料不到位、延誤 PPQ 的主因之一。
blocks.en: An incomplete BOM is often one of the main reasons materials are not in place at the Readiness stage and the PPQ is delayed.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — 跨功能 KT
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise: Cross-Functional KT

blocks.zh: Facility-fit assessment 結果顯示 RU 的混合設備容量只有 SU 的 60%，你的 TT 團隊會如何處置？改製程、買新設備、還是分批製造？
blocks.en: The facility-fit assessment shows that the RU's mixing equipment has only 60% of the SU's capacity. How would your TT team handle it: change the process, buy new equipment, or manufacture in split batches?

blocks.zh: SU 的 Regulatory 部門在歷史上曾有哪些 HA interaction？這些資訊如何影響你對 RU 監管策略的規劃？
blocks.en: What HA interactions has the SU's Regulatory department had in the past? How does this information affect your planning of the RU's regulatory strategy?

blocks.zh: 如果 Quality Risk Assessment 發現 SU 在過去 3 年有 5 件重大偏差（均已關閉），你是否仍應在 RU 制定對應的防護措施？
blocks.en: If the Quality Risk Assessment finds that the SU had 5 major deviations in the past 3 years (all closed), should you still put corresponding safeguards in place at the RU?

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — Table 5.3-1🔍 & Best Practices
blocks.en: Commentary: Table 5.3-1🔍 & Best Practices

blocks.zh: Table 5.3-1🔍 的閱讀方式
blocks.en: How to Read Table 5.3-1🔍

blocks.zh: 這張表格是 TR65 Reference Guide 的摘錄，用橫列（Function）× 縱列（Activities / Deliverables）的矩陣格式，讓你一眼看清 KT 階段每個功能的責任。
blocks.en: This table is an excerpt from the TR65 Reference Guide. It uses a matrix format of rows (Function) × columns (Activities / Deliverables) so you can see at a glance each function's responsibilities in the KT stage.

blocks.zh: 閱讀技巧：找你自己負責的功能行，確認你的 Activities 清單和 Deliverables 清單。然後橫向掃描其他功能，確認有哪些需要你配合輸入（Input）的工作。
blocks.en: Reading tip: find the row for the function you are responsible for and confirm your list of Activities and list of Deliverables. Then scan across the other functions to see which work needs your input.

blocks.zh: 舉例：Engineering 的 URS（Deliverable）是 Manufacturing 的設備佈局討論（Activity）的輸入；Analytical 的 Validation Plan（Deliverable）需要 Quality 的 QRM Report 作為風險評估基礎。
blocks.en: Example: Engineering's URS (Deliverable) is an input to Manufacturing's equipment layout discussion (Activity); Analytical's Validation Plan (Deliverable) needs Quality's QRM Report as the basis for risk assessment.

blocks.zh: KT Package — 最關鍵的「移交包裹」
blocks.en: The KT Package: The Most Critical "Handover Parcel"

blocks.zh: TT Package（知識移轉包）是 KT 階段最重要的輸出文件，通常應包含：
blocks.en: The TT Package (knowledge transfer package) is the most important output document of the KT stage and should generally contain:

blocks.zh: 製程描述與流程圖（Process Description & Flow Diagram）
blocks.en: Process Description & Flow Diagram

blocks.zh: 批次記錄範本（Master Batch Record）
blocks.en: Master Batch Record

blocks.zh: 製程參數與可接受範圍（CPPs, PAR, NOR）
blocks.en: Process parameters and acceptable ranges (CPPs, PAR, NOR)

blocks.zh: 分析方法（含轉移或驗證計畫）
blocks.en: Analytical methods (including transfer or validation plans)

blocks.zh: 清潔程序與限值依據
blocks.en: Cleaning procedures and the basis for limits

blocks.zh: 原料清單（BOM）與供應商資訊
blocks.en: Bill of Materials (BOM) and supplier information

blocks.zh: 穩定性數據與計畫
blocks.en: Stability data and plans

blocks.zh: 歷史偏差、CAPA、投訴摘要
blocks.en: Summary of historical deviations, CAPA, and complaints

blocks.zh: 監管策略與 HA interaction 記錄
blocks.en: Regulatory strategy and record of HA interactions

blocks.zh: 風險評估報告（QRM Report）
blocks.en: Risk assessment report (QRM Report)

blocks.zh: 包裹越完整，RU 在後續 Readiness 階段需要「猜測」的事情就越少。
blocks.en: The more complete the package, the less the RU has to "guess" in the later Readiness stage.

blocks.zh: Best Practice 比喻：「歷史數據是你省時間最快的方法」
blocks.en: Best Practice Analogy: "Historical Data Is the Fastest Way to Save Time"

blocks.zh: Best practice 特別強調提供 historical data（歷史數據）給 RU。道理很簡單：SU 花了 5 年積累的 CPV 報告、APR、偏差記錄，可以幫助 RU 的 process team 在幾週內就理解哪些是製程的脆弱點（Vulnerabilities）。
blocks.en: Best practice places special emphasis on providing historical data to the RU. The reasoning is simple: the CPV reports, APRs, and deviation records the SU has built up over 5 years can help the RU's process team understand within weeks where the process vulnerabilities are.

blocks.zh: 這就像入職新公司時，前輩給你一份「踩過的坑清單」——遠比你自己從頭試錯要有效率得多。
blocks.en: It is like joining a new company and having a senior colleague hand you a "list of pitfalls we have already fallen into"; this is far more efficient than learning by trial and error from scratch.

blocks.zh: 可比性策略決策樹框架
blocks.en: Comparability Strategy Decision Tree Framework

blocks.zh:
問題1：RU 製程與 SU 製程是否相同？
  ├── YES → 可比性策略：直接等同（Direct Equivalence）
  │          需要：相同設備、製程參數、原料
  └── NO → 評估差異程度

問題2：差異是否顯著（significant change）？
  ├── NO (小差異) → 橋接研究（Bridging Study）
  │                 理化比較 + 穩定性比較
  └── YES → 製程特性研究（Process Characterization）
             需要工程批 + 統計比較

問題3：可比性是否可被數據支持？
  ├── YES → 送件前無需 HA meeting
  └── Uncertain → 主動與 HA 溝通
                  考慮 Post-Approval Change Management Protocol
blocks.en:
Question 1: Is the RU process the same as the SU process?
  ├── YES → Comparability strategy: Direct Equivalence
  │          Requires: same equipment, process parameters, raw materials
  └── NO → Assess the degree of difference

Question 2: Is the difference significant (significant change)?
  ├── NO (minor difference) → Bridging Study
  │                 Physicochemical comparison + stability comparison
  └── YES → Process Characterization
             Requires engineering batches + statistical comparison

Question 3: Can comparability be supported by data?
  ├── YES → No HA meeting needed before filing
  └── Uncertain → Proactively engage the HA
                  Consider a Post-Approval Change Management Protocol

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：QbD 在接案 TT 的應用
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Applying QbD in a Contract TT

blocks.zh: Best Practice 提到使用 QbD（Quality by Design）方法在工程批之前先充分理解製程設計空間。對 CDMO 而言，這意味著：
blocks.en: Best Practice mentions using a QbD (Quality by Design) approach to fully understand the process design space before the engineering batch. For a CDMO, this means:

blocks.zh: 如果客戶有完整的 DoE 數據和 Design Space，要求他們一起移轉——不只是規格，還有設計邏輯
blocks.en: If the client has complete DoE data and a Design Space, ask that they be transferred as well: not only the specifications but also the design logic

blocks.zh: 如果是開發中產品，CDMO 可能需要自行執行製程特性研究（Process Characterization）
blocks.en: For a product still in development, the CDMO may need to carry out Process Characterization itself

blocks.zh: QbD 的目的不是多做實驗，而是在 PPQ 前就知道製程的邊界在哪裡，避免 PPQ 失敗
blocks.en: The purpose of QbD is not to run more experiments but to know where the process boundaries are before PPQ, so as to avoid PPQ failure

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — Readiness 階段總覽
blocks.en: Commentary: Overview of the Readiness Stage

blocks.zh: Readiness 的本質：「上場前的最後整備」
blocks.en: The Essence of Readiness: "Final Preparation Before Going On Stage"

blocks.zh: Readiness 階段的英文字面意義就是「準備好了」。在這個階段，TT 團隊需要完成的任務是：確保 RU 在進入 Execution（PPQ）之前，所有條件都已備齊且經過確認。
blocks.en: The literal meaning of Readiness is "being ready." In this stage the TT team must complete the following: ensure that before the RU enters Execution (PPQ), all conditions are in place and confirmed.

blocks.zh: 三大備齊要素：
blocks.en: Three elements that must be in place:

blocks.zh: 文件備齊：所有 SOP、批記、驗證協議都已撰寫並核准
blocks.en: Documents in place: all SOPs, batch records, and validation protocols are written and approved

blocks.zh: 設備備齊：所有設備已安裝且完成資格確認（IQ/OQ/PQ）
blocks.en: Equipment in place: all equipment is installed and qualified (IQ/OQ/PQ)

blocks.zh: 人員備齊：所有操作人員已完成訓練，記錄在案
blocks.en: Personnel in place: all operators have completed training, with records on file

blocks.zh: 任何一項未完成，都不得進入 Execution 階段。
blocks.en: If any one item is incomplete, the Execution stage must not begin.

blocks.zh: Stage Gate — Readiness 關卡的意義
blocks.en: Stage Gate: The Meaning of the Readiness Gate

blocks.zh: Readiness 的 Stage Gate 是由指導委員會（Steering Committee）主持的正式審查。這不是一個形式性的行政蓋章，而是一個技術與商業雙重審查：
blocks.en: The Readiness Stage Gate is a formal review chaired by the Steering Committee. It is not an administrative rubber stamp but a dual technical and business review:

blocks.zh: 技術面：所有驗證文件是否準備好？設備是否已完成資格確認？
blocks.en: Technical: are all validation documents ready? Has the equipment completed qualification?

blocks.zh: 商業面：資源、預算、時程是否仍在 TT charter 的範圍內？
blocks.en: Business: are resources, budget, and schedule still within the scope of the TT charter?

blocks.zh: 風險面：殘餘風險是否已有緩解計畫？
blocks.en: Risk: do the residual risks have mitigation plans?

blocks.zh: TR65 Section 8.11 的案例研究特別強調：跳過 Stage Gate 直接進入 Execution，是 TT 失敗最常見的原因之一。
blocks.en: The case study in TR65 Section 8.11 specifically stresses that skipping the Stage Gate and going straight into Execution is one of the most common reasons TTs fail.

blocks.zh: 比喻：開刀前的手術室核對清單
blocks.en: Analogy: The Operating Room Checklist Before Surgery

blocks.zh: Readiness Stage Gate 就像外科手術前的 WHO Surgical Safety Checklist：
blocks.en: The Readiness Stage Gate is like the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist before surgery:

blocks.zh: 「病人確認了嗎？」= 產品規格確認了嗎？
blocks.en: "Has the patient been confirmed?" = Have the product specifications been confirmed?

blocks.zh: 「器械都消毒完成了嗎？」= 設備資格確認通過了嗎？
blocks.en: "Are all instruments sterilized?" = Has equipment qualification passed?

blocks.zh: 「所有人員都就位了嗎？」= 人員訓練完成了嗎？
blocks.en: "Is everyone in position?" = Has personnel training been completed?

blocks.zh: 「麻醉師確認可以開始了嗎？」= Steering Committee 批准了嗎？
blocks.en: "Has the anesthesiologist confirmed we can begin?" = Has the Steering Committee approved?

blocks.zh: 這個清單的存在，不是為了懷疑手術團隊的能力，而是系統性防止遺漏。
blocks.en: The checklist exists not to doubt the ability of the surgical team but to systematically prevent omissions.

blocks.zh: TT Protocol — 整合型驗證計畫書
blocks.en: TT Protocol: An Integrated Validation Plan

blocks.zh: TT PM 在 Readiness 階段建立的 TT Protocol 是一份整合性文件，把各功能分頭寫的計畫匯整成一份：
blocks.en: The TT Protocol that the TT PM builds in the Readiness stage is an integrated document that consolidates the plans each function wrote separately into one:

blocks.zh: Process VMP → PPQ 的執行要求
blocks.en: Process VMP → execution requirements for PPQ

blocks.zh: Cleaning VMP → 清潔驗證的執行要求
blocks.en: Cleaning VMP → execution requirements for cleaning validation

blocks.zh: Analytical Validation Plan → 方法執行清單
blocks.en: Analytical Validation Plan → list of method activities to be executed

blocks.zh: Stability Plan → 穩定性採樣時間點
blocks.en: Stability Plan → stability sampling time points

blocks.zh: Sampling Plan → 各批次採樣位置與頻率
blocks.en: Sampling Plan → sampling locations and frequency for each batch

blocks.zh: TT Protocol 是 Steering Committee 在 Readiness Stage Gate 審查的核心文件之一。
blocks.en: The TT Protocol is one of the core documents the Steering Committee reviews at the Readiness Stage Gate.

blocks.zh: Control Strategy 終版：Readiness 的核心任務
blocks.en: Final Control Strategy: The Core Task of Readiness

blocks.zh: Control Strategy（管制策略）在 Readiness 階段必須定版（Finalized）。它定義了：
blocks.en: The Control Strategy must be finalized in the Readiness stage. It defines:

blocks.zh: Hold Points：哪些步驟需要暫停等待檢測結果？
blocks.en: Hold Points: which steps must pause to wait for test results?

blocks.zh: In-Process Sampling：在製程哪個位置、用什麼方法、取多少樣品？
blocks.en: In-Process Sampling: where in the process, by what method, and how much sample is taken?

blocks.zh: CPPs 與 Ranges：每個關鍵製程參數的可接受範圍
blocks.en: CPPs and Ranges: the acceptable range of each critical process parameter

blocks.zh: Critical Unit Operations：哪些步驟被認定為關鍵操作？
blocks.en: Critical Unit Operations: which steps are identified as critical operations?

blocks.zh: 黃金法則：一旦 Readiness 階段關閉（Stage Gate 通過），就不能再對製程引入新的條件或變數。PPQ 批次必須在「鎖定」的控制策略下執行。
blocks.en: Golden rule: once the Readiness stage is closed (the Stage Gate is passed), no new conditions or variables may be introduced into the process. PPQ batches must be run under a "locked" control strategy.

blocks.zh: 製程驗證協議的必要元素（PV Protocol Checklist）
blocks.en: Required Elements of the Process Validation Protocol (PV Protocol Checklist)

blocks.zh:
Process Validation Protocol 必須包含：
□ 製程描述（Process Description）
□ 製程流程圖（Process Flow Diagram）
□ 批次大小與預期收率（Batch Size & Expected Yield）
□ 所有 CPPs 及其可接受範圍（PAR/NOR）
□ 採樣計畫（Sampling Plan）——位置、時點、頻率
□ 分析測試清單（Analytical Testing Strategy）
□ Hold Points 定義
□ 成功標準（Acceptance Criteria）——需預先設定
□ 偏差處理規則（Deviation Handling Plan）
□ 數據蒐集與完整性要求（Data Integrity Plan）
□ 統計方法（如適用）
□ 核准人員清單（Approval Matrix）
blocks.en:
The Process Validation Protocol must include:
□ Process Description
□ Process Flow Diagram
□ Batch Size & Expected Yield
□ All CPPs and their acceptable ranges (PAR/NOR)
□ Sampling Plan: locations, time points, frequency
□ Analytical Testing Strategy
□ Definition of Hold Points
□ Acceptance Criteria: must be set in advance
□ Deviation Handling Plan
□ Data collection and integrity requirements (Data Integrity Plan)
□ Statistical methods (if applicable)
□ List of approvers (Approval Matrix)

blocks.zh: Analytical — Readiness 的關鍵：方法必須已執行
blocks.en: Analytical: The Key to Readiness Is That Methods Must Already Be Executed

blocks.zh: 注意 KT 與 Readiness 的差別：
blocks.en: Note the difference between KT and Readiness:

blocks.zh: KT 階段：制定驗證計畫（Plan）
blocks.en: KT stage: develop the validation plan (Plan)

blocks.zh: Readiness 階段：執行並完成驗證（Execute & Complete）
blocks.en: Readiness stage: execute and complete the validation (Execute & Complete)

blocks.zh: 在進入 Execution（PPQ）之前，所有的分析方法必須是已驗證（Validated）或已轉移（Transferred）的狀態。使用未驗證方法的 PPQ 批次，其放行數據的法規合規性將受到質疑。
blocks.en: Before entering Execution (PPQ), all analytical methods must be in a validated or transferred state. For PPQ batches tested with unvalidated methods, the regulatory compliance of the release data will be questioned.

blocks.zh: 此外，穩定性協議（Stability Protocols）也必須在 Readiness 完成，因為 PPQ 第一批就要啟動穩定性放置。
blocks.en: In addition, the stability protocols must also be completed in Readiness, because stability placement has to start with the first PPQ batch.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — Readiness 前半段
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise: First Half of Readiness

blocks.zh: 你的 TT Protocol 是由誰負責撰寫？TT PM 還是 Process？兩者如何分工？
blocks.en: Who is responsible for writing your TT Protocol: the TT PM or Process? How do the two divide the work?

blocks.zh: 如果 Analytical 的某個方法轉移在 Readiness 結束前未能完成，TT PM 應如何評估是否影響 Stage Gate 通過？
blocks.en: If an Analytical method transfer cannot be completed before the end of Readiness, how should the TT PM assess whether it affects passing the Stage Gate?

blocks.zh: Engineering Batch 與 PPQ Batch 的差別是什麼？Engineering Batch 可以作為商業批次放行嗎？
blocks.en: What is the difference between an Engineering Batch and a PPQ Batch? Can an Engineering Batch be released as a commercial batch?

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — Engineering 至 Supply Chain (Readiness)
blocks.en: Commentary: Engineering through Supply Chain (Readiness)

blocks.zh: FAT / SAT / IQ / OQ / PQ 的關係
blocks.en: How FAT / SAT / IQ / OQ / PQ Relate

blocks.zh: 設備資格確認的完整流程：
blocks.en: The complete equipment qualification flow:

blocks.zh: FAT（工廠驗收測試）：在廠商工廠進行，確認設備符合 URS 規格，在出廠前確認問題
blocks.en: FAT (Factory Acceptance Test): performed at the vendor's factory to confirm the equipment meets URS specifications and to catch problems before shipment

blocks.zh: SAT（場址驗收測試）：設備運抵 RU 後，確認運輸和安裝未損壞，基本功能正常
blocks.en: SAT (Site Acceptance Test): after the equipment arrives at the RU, confirms that transport and installation caused no damage and basic functions work

blocks.zh: IQ（安裝資格確認）：確認設備按照設計和製造商規格正確安裝
blocks.en: IQ (Installation Qualification): confirms the equipment is installed correctly according to the design and manufacturer's specifications

blocks.zh: OQ（操作資格確認）：確認設備在規定操作範圍內正常運行
blocks.en: OQ (Operational Qualification): confirms the equipment operates properly within the specified operating ranges

blocks.zh: PQ（性能資格確認）：確認設備在實際生產條件下持續符合要求
blocks.en: PQ (Performance Qualification): confirms the equipment consistently meets requirements under actual production conditions

blocks.zh: Capital VMP 的技巧：把 FAT/SAT 的測試數據直接作為 IQ/OQ 的依據，可以減少 Readiness 階段的文件工作量，加快資格確認進度。
blocks.en: A Capital VMP tip: using FAT/SAT test data directly as the basis for IQ/OQ reduces the documentation workload in the Readiness stage and speeds up qualification.

blocks.zh: Engineering 的兩個「最後動作」
blocks.en: Engineering's Two "Final Actions"

blocks.zh: 在 Readiness 階段結束前，Engineering 必須完成兩件事，之後才能離開「主角舞台」轉為支援角色：
blocks.en: Before the end of the Readiness stage, Engineering must complete two things, after which it can step out of the "lead role" and move to a supporting role:

blocks.zh: 預防性保養計畫（Preventive Maintenance Plan）：設備上線後如何維護？每隔多久要做什麼保養？由 Manufacturing 執行，但 Engineering 設計。
blocks.en: Preventive Maintenance Plan: how will the equipment be maintained once it is in service? What maintenance is done at what interval? Executed by Manufacturing but designed by Engineering.

blocks.zh: 備件清單（Spare Parts Requirements）：哪些零件是關鍵備件，應常備？交期多長的零件需要先採購？
blocks.en: Spare Parts Requirements: which parts are critical spares that should always be in stock? Which parts have long lead times and need to be purchased in advance?

blocks.zh: 這兩件事如果遺漏，在商業生產階段往往會因設備故障或停機而付出高昂代價。
blocks.en: If these two items are missed, the commercial production stage often pays a high price through equipment failure or downtime.

blocks.zh: Quality 的 Readiness 核查清單
blocks.en: Quality's Readiness Checklist

blocks.zh: Quality 在 Readiness 階段承擔「最終守門員」角色，進入 PPQ 前必須確認：
blocks.en: Quality plays the role of "final gatekeeper" in the Readiness stage and must confirm the following before PPQ:

blocks.zh: 所有偏差（Deviation）已關閉
blocks.en: All deviations are closed

blocks.zh: 所有 CAPA 已完成並有效性確認
blocks.en: All CAPAs are completed and effectiveness has been confirmed

blocks.zh: 所有變更管制（Change Controls）已關閉
blocks.en: All change controls are closed

blocks.zh: PPQ 批次放行程序（Batch Release Procedure）已建立並與 SU 對齊
blocks.en: The PPQ batch release procedure is established and aligned with the SU

blocks.zh: 合格人員（QP/RP）的角色已定義
blocks.en: The role of the Qualified Person (QP/RP) is defined

blocks.zh: PAI 準備計畫已制定
blocks.en: The PAI preparation plan is in place

blocks.zh: 高風險供應商稽核已完成
blocks.en: High-risk supplier audits are completed

blocks.zh: 重點：帶著未關閉的偏差或 CAPA 進入 PPQ，是監管機關在 PAI 中最容易發現的缺陷之一。
blocks.en: Key point: entering PPQ with open deviations or CAPAs is one of the easiest deficiencies for regulators to find during a PAI.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Regulatory 的 Submission Tracker 像「出版編輯時間表」
blocks.en: Analogy: Regulatory's Submission Tracker Is Like a "Publishing Editorial Schedule"

blocks.zh: Submission Tracker 是 Regulatory 在 Readiness 階段建立的申報文件管理工具，其邏輯就像書籍出版的編輯時間表：
blocks.en: The Submission Tracker is a tool Regulatory builds in the Readiness stage to manage filing documents. Its logic is like the editorial schedule of a book:

blocks.zh: 每份文件有負責撰寫的作者（Author）
blocks.en: Each document has an author responsible for writing it

blocks.zh: 有審查者（Reviewer）和核准者（Approver）
blocks.en: There are reviewers and approvers

blocks.zh: 有各節點的截止日期
blocks.en: There are deadlines for each milestone

blocks.zh: 有 RACI 矩陣標示責任
blocks.en: There is a RACI matrix showing responsibilities

blocks.zh: 所有時間點都要與「數據何時能取得」的時間軸對齊——若穩定性數據預計 T+6 個月才有，申報文件的撰寫時程就不能排在 T+4。
blocks.en: All dates must be aligned with the timeline of "when the data will be available": if stability data are expected at T+6 months, the filing document cannot be scheduled for writing at T+4.

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：PAI 準備的提前量
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Lead Time for PAI Preparation

blocks.zh: 對於在 Readiness 階段已開始規劃 PAI（Pre-Approval Inspection）準備的 CDMO，有幾個實務重點：
blocks.en: For a CDMO that has started planning for the PAI (Pre-Approval Inspection) in the Readiness stage, there are several practical points:

blocks.zh: PAI 的時間是由監管機關決定的，CDMO 應假設可能在 PPQ 批次完成後 6-12 個月內到廠
blocks.en: The timing of a PAI is decided by the regulator; the CDMO should assume the inspection may come 6-12 months after the PPQ batches are completed

blocks.zh: Mock Inspection（模擬查廠）應在 PAI 前執行，找出並在正式查廠前改善缺口
blocks.en: A mock inspection should be run before the PAI to find gaps and fix them before the actual inspection

blocks.zh: Electronic Batch Records、Use Tests 等 RU 特有的系統，需要提前向 SU/MAH 說明，確保雙方的放行程序（Release Procedure）是一致的
blocks.en: RU-specific systems such as electronic batch records and use tests need to be explained to the SU/MAH in advance, to make sure the release procedures of both sides are consistent

blocks.zh: PAI Readiness Plan 應該是一份活文件，隨 Execution 階段的數據不斷更新
blocks.en: The PAI Readiness Plan should be a living document, updated continuously with data from the Execution stage

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — Readiness 後半段
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise: Second Half of Readiness

blocks.zh: 你們公司的 Quality 在 PPQ 前的 CAPA 關閉要求是什麼？有無「重要程度分級」——高風險 CAPA 必須全部關閉，低風險允許有計畫地關閉？
blocks.en: What is your company's Quality requirement for CAPA closure before PPQ? Is there a risk-based classification, so that high-risk CAPAs must all be closed while low-risk ones may be closed under a plan?

blocks.zh: 如果一台關鍵設備的 OQ 在 Stage Gate 前一週才能完成，你會如何與 Steering Committee 溝通這個風險？
blocks.en: If the OQ of a critical piece of equipment can only be completed one week before the Stage Gate, how would you communicate this risk to the Steering Committee?

blocks.zh: Supply Chain 的材料交期已知是關鍵路徑，如果某個原料供應商突然通知延誤 4 週，你的應急計畫是什麼？
blocks.en: Supply Chain knows the material lead time is on the critical path. If a raw material supplier suddenly announces a 4-week delay, what is your contingency plan?

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — Table 5.4-1🔍 & Best Practices
blocks.en: Commentary: Table 5.4-1🔍 & Best Practices

blocks.zh: Readiness Stage Gate 評估框架
blocks.en: Readiness Stage Gate Assessment Framework

blocks.zh:
Readiness Stage Gate 檢核（Steering Committee 視角）：

【文件備齊度 Documentation Readiness】
□ TT Protocol — 已完成並核准？
□ Process VMP + PV Protocol — 已完成並核准？
□ Cleaning VMP + CV Protocol — 已完成並核准？
□ Analytical Validation Reports — 全部已完成？
□ Master Batch Records + SOPs — 已完成並核准？
□ All Change Controls — 已關閉？

【設備備齊度 Equipment Readiness】
□ 所有設備 IQ/OQ/PQ — 完成並通過？
□ Capital Qualification Reports — 已簽核？
□ Equipment Readiness Approval — 已取得？
□ PM Plan 和備件清單 — 已建立？

【人員備齊度 Personnel Readiness】
□ 操作人員訓練記錄 — 完整歸檔？
□ QA 人員對製程熟悉度 — 培訓完成？
□ Engineering 設備操作訓練 — 完成？

【品質備齊度 Quality Readiness】
□ 所有偏差/CAPA — 已關閉？
□ PPQ Batch Release Procedure — 已建立？
□ 供應商資格確認稽核 — 完成？
□ PAI Readiness Plan — 已起草？

【材料備齊度 Material Readiness】
□ 所有物料已採購並放行？
□ 庫存系統已設定？
□ 倉庫已設置？

結論：全部 □ = 可進入 Execution
      任何 □ 未達成 = 記錄風險 + 制定緩解計畫
blocks.en:
Readiness Stage Gate Checklist (Steering Committee perspective):

[Documentation Readiness]
□ TT Protocol: completed and approved?
□ Process VMP + PV Protocol: completed and approved?
□ Cleaning VMP + CV Protocol: completed and approved?
□ Analytical Validation Reports: all completed?
□ Master Batch Records + SOPs: completed and approved?
□ All Change Controls: closed?

[Equipment Readiness]
□ IQ/OQ/PQ for all equipment: completed and passed?
□ Capital Qualification Reports: signed off?
□ Equipment Readiness Approval: obtained?
□ PM Plan and spare parts list: established?

[Personnel Readiness]
□ Operator training records: complete and filed?
□ QA staff familiarity with the process: training completed?
□ Engineering equipment operation training: completed?

[Quality Readiness]
□ All deviations/CAPAs: closed?
□ PPQ Batch Release Procedure: established?
□ Supplier qualification audits: completed?
□ PAI Readiness Plan: drafted?

[Material Readiness]
□ All materials purchased and released?
□ Inventory system set up?
□ Warehouse set up?

Conclusion: all □ complete = may proceed to Execution
      any □ not met = record the risk + develop a mitigation plan

blocks.zh: Best Practice：三個「早確認、留緩衝」原則
blocks.en: Best Practice: Three Principles of "Confirm Early, Leave a Buffer"

blocks.zh: Readiness Best Practices 反覆強調一個模式：
blocks.en: The Readiness Best Practices repeatedly emphasize one pattern:

blocks.zh: 早確認交期（材料/設備）：Lead time 長的項目，在 Planning 階段就要下單，不能等到 Readiness 才開始問廠商
blocks.en: Confirm lead times early (materials/equipment): items with long lead times must be ordered in the Planning stage; you cannot wait until Readiness to start asking vendors

blocks.zh: 留足夠緩衝：所有時程估算都要加 buffer。Pharma TT 中，「剛好夠」的時程計畫幾乎必然失敗
blocks.en: Leave enough buffer: add a buffer to every schedule estimate. In pharma TT, a "just enough" schedule almost inevitably fails

blocks.zh: 定期查核（不要假設廠商會自動告訴你問題）：Supply chain 風險中最常見的是廠商延誤了幾週才告知 CDMO，這時候已沒有足夠時間應對
blocks.en: Check regularly (do not assume vendors will tell you about problems on their own): the most common supply chain risk is a vendor delaying several weeks before telling the CDMO, by which time there is not enough time to respond

blocks.zh: Risk Register — Readiness 階段的風險儀表板
blocks.en: Risk Register: The Risk Dashboard for the Readiness Stage

blocks.zh: Risk Register 在 Readiness 階段是一份活文件，每個風險應有：
blocks.en: The Risk Register is a living document in the Readiness stage, and each risk should have:

blocks.zh: 風險描述：什麼可能出錯？
blocks.en: Risk description: what could go wrong?

blocks.zh: 影響程度：對品質、時程、成本的影響（高/中/低）
blocks.en: Impact: effect on quality, schedule, and cost (high/medium/low)

blocks.zh: 發生機率：（高/中/低）
blocks.en: Probability: (high/medium/low)

blocks.zh: 風險等級：影響 × 機率
blocks.en: Risk level: impact × probability

blocks.zh: 緩解計畫：採取什麼行動降低風險？
blocks.en: Mitigation plan: what action will be taken to reduce the risk?

blocks.zh: 負責人：誰負責執行緩解計畫？
blocks.en: Owner: who is responsible for carrying out the mitigation plan?

blocks.zh: 截止日期：緩解計畫何時完成？
blocks.en: Due date: when will the mitigation plan be completed?

blocks.zh: 現況：Open / In Progress / Closed
blocks.en: Status: Open / In Progress / Closed

blocks.zh: Steering Committee 在 Stage Gate 時應審查 Risk Register，確認所有 High Risk 項目都有對應的緩解計畫且進度符合預期。
blocks.en: At the Stage Gate the Steering Committee should review the Risk Register and confirm that every High Risk item has a corresponding mitigation plan and that progress is as expected.

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：Readiness Checklist 的實用設計
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Practical Design of the Readiness Checklist

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，Readiness Checklist 應按功能分區，可做成 Excel 或數位工具，包含：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the Readiness Checklist should be divided by function, can be built in Excel or a digital tool, and includes:

blocks.zh: 每個交付物（Deliverable）一行
blocks.en: One row for each deliverable

blocks.zh: 狀態欄：Not Started / In Progress / Complete / Waived with Justification
blocks.en: Status column: Not Started / In Progress / Complete / Waived with Justification

blocks.zh: 負責人欄 + 預計完成日欄 + 實際完成日欄
blocks.en: Owner column + planned completion date column + actual completion date column

blocks.zh: 備註欄：說明任何例外或依賴關係
blocks.en: Remarks column: explains any exceptions or dependencies

blocks.zh: 每週 TT Team 會議時更新，TT PM 追蹤整體完成度。Checklist 完成度達 100%（或有書面記錄的例外）才能向 Steering Committee 申請 Stage Gate 會議。
blocks.en: Updated at each weekly TT Team meeting, with the TT PM tracking overall completion. The Checklist must reach 100% completion (or have documented exceptions) before a Stage Gate meeting is requested from the Steering Committee.

blocks.zh: 中文總結 — 本節關鍵要點
blocks.en: Summary: Key Points of This Section

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境下的實踐要點
blocks.en: Practical Points in a CDMO Environment

blocks.zh: 主動識別知識缺口：不要等待 SU 自動提供，要帶著問題清單去 KT
blocks.en: Identify knowledge gaps proactively: do not wait for the SU to provide everything; go into KT with a list of questions

blocks.zh: 隱性知識捕捉系統化：現場示範要有記錄機制（錄影、書面備忘），不能只靠人腦記憶
blocks.en: Capture tacit knowledge systematically: on-site demonstrations need a recording mechanism (video, written memos); you cannot rely on memory alone

blocks.zh: KT Package 品質要求高：進入 Readiness 前，TT Package 中的關鍵文件版本必須由 Regulatory 確認
blocks.en: High quality requirements for the KT Package: before entering Readiness, the versions of key documents in the TT Package must be confirmed by Regulatory

blocks.zh: Stage Gate 不可妥協：即使客戶催促上市時間，Readiness Stage Gate 是保護 CDMO 和客戶雙方的防線
blocks.en: The Stage Gate is non-negotiable: even when the client is pressing on time to market, the Readiness Stage Gate is the line of defense that protects both the CDMO and the client

blocks.zh: 材料前置時間是關鍵路徑：Supply Chain 在 KT 階段就要開始確認長交期物料的訂購時機
blocks.en: Material lead time is the critical path: Supply Chain must start confirming the ordering timing of long-lead-time materials already in the KT stage

blocks.zh: TR65 兩階段關鍵術語速查
blocks.en: Quick Reference: Key Terms for the Two TR65 Stages

blocks.zh:
KT Stage 核心術語：
  KM = Knowledge Management (知識管理)
  TT Package = Technology Transfer Package (技術移轉包)
  Explicit Knowledge = 顯性知識（文件記錄的）
  Tacit Knowledge = 隱性知識（人員經驗）
  VMP = Validation Master Plan (驗證主計畫)
  URS = User Requirements Specification (使用者需求規格)
  QRM = Quality Risk Management (品質風險管理)
  BOM = Bill of Materials (物料清單)
  CPV = Continued Process Verification (持續製程驗證)
  APR = Annual Product Review (年度產品審查)

Readiness Stage 核心術語：
  TT Protocol = TT 協議書（整合型計畫文件）
  Control Strategy = 管制策略
  FAT = Factory Acceptance Test (工廠驗收測試)
  SAT = Site Acceptance Test (場址驗收測試)
  IQ/OQ/PQ = 安裝/操作/性能資格確認
  EHS = Environmental, Health & Safety (環境健康安全)
  PAI = Pre-Approval Inspection (上市前查廠)
  CAPA = Corrective and Preventive Action (矯正與預防措施)
  RACI = Responsible/Accountable/Consulted/Informed
  QP = Qualified Person (合格人員，歐盟法規要求)
blocks.en:
KT Stage key terms:
  KM = Knowledge Management
  TT Package = Technology Transfer Package
  Explicit Knowledge = knowledge recorded in documents
  Tacit Knowledge = knowledge held as personal experience
  VMP = Validation Master Plan
  URS = User Requirements Specification
  QRM = Quality Risk Management
  BOM = Bill of Materials
  CPV = Continued Process Verification
  APR = Annual Product Review

Readiness Stage key terms:
  TT Protocol = integrated plan document for the TT
  Control Strategy
  FAT = Factory Acceptance Test
  SAT = Site Acceptance Test
  IQ/OQ/PQ = Installation/Operational/Performance Qualification
  EHS = Environmental, Health & Safety
  PAI = Pre-Approval Inspection
  CAPA = Corrective and Preventive Action
  RACI = Responsible/Accountable/Consulted/Informed
  QP = Qualified Person (required under EU regulations)

blocks.zh: 與其他 PDA TR 的連結
blocks.en: Links to Other PDA TRs

blocks.zh: PDA TR60 (Process Validation Lifecycle)：KT 階段的 Process VMP 及 CPP 分類方法，直接對應 TR60 的 Stage 1（製程設計）與 Stage 2（製程驗證）框架
blocks.en: PDA TR60 (Process Validation Lifecycle): the Process VMP and the CPP classification approach in the KT stage map directly to TR60's Stage 1 (Process Design) and Stage 2 (Process Qualification) framework

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System)：Readiness 階段的 Control Strategy 終版是 ICH Q10 PQS 的核心要件，特別是製程參數的分類與範圍設定
blocks.en: ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System): the final Control Strategy in the Readiness stage is a core element of the ICH Q10 PQS, especially the classification of process parameters and the setting of ranges

blocks.zh: ICH Q8 (Pharmaceutical Development)：KT Best Practice 中的 QbD 方法直接對應 ICH Q8 的 Design Space 概念
blocks.en: ICH Q8 (Pharmaceutical Development): the QbD approach in the KT Best Practice maps directly to the ICH Q8 concept of Design Space

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management)：KT 和 Readiness 兩階段的 QRM Report 和 Risk Register 是 ICH Q9 的應用實踐
blocks.en: ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management): the QRM Report and Risk Register across the KT and Readiness stages are applications of ICH Q9 in practice
